category_title: EFL children with learning difficulties exhibiting behavioral disengagement and low motivation
minimal_context: The student is participating in a group storytelling session where they are expected to listen to a physical storybook being read and act it out.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Alright everyone, please gather around. I am going to hold this storybook and read it to you, and I want you to listen and act it out with me.

STUDENT: Why do we have to be away from our classroom? I want to return to my own classroom to do the homework I was supposed to finish.

TUTOR: We need to stay here for the story right now. Let's begin reading.

STUDENT: I simply do not like English, no matter what you do.

TUTOR: Let's just give it a try. Look at the book while I read and act out this first part.

STUDENT: (Completely ignores the storyteller and starts playing with a pencil and strips of paper) This story is boring! (Stands up and starts running around the room)

options.A: Put down the physical storybook and use body language, voice, and gestures to act out the story.
options.B: Withhold all attention from the student while they are engaging in the problem behavior.
options.C: Provide the student with praise for specific desirable behaviors at least once every two minutes.
options.D: Step in the direction of the student and stand one meter or less from them while talking.
